question: Should OpenClaw reserve the top-level `auth` CLI root for core model-auth shortcuts despite the existing plugin-owned root command contract?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but choosing permanent ownership of a public plugin-visible command root requires explicit CLI/plugin product policy.

options.title: Keep the models namespace
options.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as the sole core listing surface and close this alias PR to preserve the plugin root namespace.

options.title: Reserve auth for core
options.body: Sponsor `auth` as a core-reserved root and require an explicit plugin collision, migration, documentation, and live-proof plan before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep the models namespace
recommendation.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as the sole core listing surface and close this alias PR to preserve the plugin root namespace.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to both the canonical model-auth command and recent plugin CLI behavior.
